meta.title: Zeno: teach and learn online
meta.description: A secure video and live-class platform for Indian educators.

home.title: Teach on your terms. Get paid in rupees.
home.subtitle: Zeno is a secure video and live-class platform for Indian educators. Your lessons stay yours, and your students pay by UPI.
home.secureBody: Video is streamed encrypted and tied to the student who bought it, so it cannot be downloaded and passed around.
home.payBody: UPI, cards and net banking. Earnings are tracked to the paisa and paid out to your bank account.
home.liveBody: Teach live to a class, then keep the recording as a course. One place for both.
